location.description: The location of the Backend that this Domain is associated with
location.rationale: Location inherits from backend configuration and has no independent security policy.

backend.description: The ID of the Backend that this Domain is associated with
backend.rationale: Backend ID is a reference with no direct security implications.

domain_id.description: Id of the domain. For default domain, it should be {{backend}}--{{project_id}}.{{location}}.hosted.app
domain_id.rationale: Default domain ID follows a standard format with no specific security policy.

disabled.description: Whether the domain is disabled. Defaults to false.
disabled.rationale: Domain enable/disable flag has no specific security policy.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project specification uses default provider project when not specified.
